subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Her __sarcastic__ comment earned a few chuckles from the audience, who understood the irony in her words.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sarcastic"** means marked by or given to using irony in order to mock or convey contempt. (व्यंग्यपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **Her **sarcastic** tone often made it difficult for others to know when she was joking.
 
 
 
• **"Courteous"** refers to being polite, respectful, or considerate in manner. (विनम्र)
 
 
• **Example: **He was very **courteous** to the guests, ensuring they had everything they needed.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'sarcastic'** is **'courteous'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unsavoury** (अप्रिय): Disagreeable to taste, smell, or look at.

 
 
• **Example:** The unsavoury smell from the garbage made everyone feel nauseous.
 
 
 
• **Sardonic** (व्यंग्यपूर्ण): Grimly mocking or cynical.
 
 
• **Example:** He gave her a sardonic smile when she asked for his help.
 
 
 
• **Humorous** (हास्यपूर्ण): Causing laughter and amusement; comic.
 
 
• **Example:** His humorous anecdotes always lightened the mood during meetings.
 
 

4e:Tbf5,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
